title: Generalizing Deep Learning for Medical Image Segmentation to Unseen Domains via Deep Stacked Transformation (BigAug)
mechanism: Nine stacked random transforms (blur, sharpen, noise, brightness, contrast, gamma, elastic, rotation, scale) on a single source simulate unseen-domain shift.
evidence: Trained on 10 to 32 volumes: unseen-domain Dice drop 11% vs 39% with conventional augmentation and 25% with CycleGAN DA; with 465 volumes it matches in-domain models.
adaptation: Widen the label-safe policy: blur sigma <= 0.7 px, sharpen, Gaussian noise, gamma 0.7 to 1.5, scale 0.85 to 1.15 with nearest-neighbour labels, small elastic. No large blur (it would erase 1 px cracks).
min_experiment: PF+BigAug-lite vs PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU; guard test crack IoU. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or test crack IoU drop > 0.01.
prior_overlap: None: only flips, rot90 and brightness/contrast were ever used.
